note: Hand-labelled memos from features/imports/data/bank_transactions_sample.xlsx. `student` is the expected top-ranked student, written 'FirstName LastName' as stored in the students table; matching is case- and space-insensitive. `student: null` with kind 'not_student' means the row is not a student payment at all (bank noise, another school, a refund). Only cases whose correct answer is determinable from the memo plus the student directory are listed — do not guess labels, an unlabelled row is better than a wrong one. `charge` is the fee_name the payment should land on when that is unambiguous.
